action_ja: 草原すれすれの低空飛行
prompt_en: The exact same Mio makes one smooth low-altitude forward flight and controlled deceleration while staying about one body-height above an unseen floor. The whole robot leans forward only five degrees, then gradually returns upright; the rounded triangular head, black neck connector, torso, pelvis, and legs remain correctly aligned in one forward direction at every moment. Both amber eyes stay unchanged. The tiny sealed service seam below the eyes remains rigid and closed and never moves like a mouth. Arms stay low for balance, legs move from slight trailing alignment toward a legs-down landing-ready posture. No head turn, reversed neck, twisted body, mouth movement, running, swimming, wing, jetpack, flame, exhaust, speech, or redesign. Locked camera and neutral studio background.
